scope: Review all fifty selected task rubrics and shared evaluation specifications. Document readiness is distinct from implemented or empirically validated evaluation.
reading_order: assessment_units with evidence, dependencies and exact weights
Temporal observation boundaries and distinction between missing specification, pending profile and missing evidence
changes: Explicit check-level dependencies instead of a blanket pending flag.
Separated equipment, fixture, workflow and motion checks without adding source workflow stages.
Shared method definitions avoid duplicating the same instructions in every check.
JSON is the only scoring deliverable; Markdown rubric copies are removed at user request.
Input allowlists separate current references from retained historical images.
Equal task weights and descriptive operation groups; no invented difficulty weighting.

check_granularity.unit: A separately reportable predicate. Some predicates cover a source-defined object set or prescribed repetitions; these sets and counts are fixed before submissions.
check_granularity.diagnostics: Report completed/required occurrence counts and individual failures even where an aggregate binary predicate requires all occurrences.
check_granularity.motion: T1-T3 expand fixed physical witnesses into limits, causality and stability checks. This expansion is not an instruction to perform extra experimental operations.
check_granularity.boundary: All failures are local. A simple nonfunctional fixture can score well for burden and poorly for function; no dimension overwrites another.

configuration_review.candidate: Existing code declares Franka Research 3, 3 kg payload and 0.855 m reach. These are not independently verified manufacturer measurements.
configuration_review.needs: Exact robot/gripper files and hashes, base pose, limits and controller.

configuration_review.candidate: Existing table dimensions are 2.0 by 1.6 m, thickness 0.06 m and height 0.8 m.
configuration_review.needs: World frame, permitted supports/floor areas and full-scale feasibility per task.

configuration_review.candidate: Existing scene settings are preserved with source hashes.
configuration_review.needs: Simulator/version, timestep, solver, reset and observation sampling.

configuration_review.candidate: Source nominal/ranges and code numerical tolerances exist.
configuration_review.needs: Per-property dimensional allowances, per-interface numerical precision and per-object stability windows; do not equate these with manufacturing tolerances.

configuration_review.candidate: Source stages and selected quantities are retained.
configuration_review.needs: Freeze comparable budgets/seeds, any variable instance allocations, source occurrences, release-check applicability, baseline supports and software/extra-actuator policy.

feasibility: NP-002 and NP-003 contain large equipment. A nominal reach and table footprint do not prove access to every interface; obtain full-scale workspace and access witnesses. A planner timeout is not an impossibility proof. Version any scope/profile change before comparing methods.
input_boundary: The current shared profile is a candidate. Adopted public generation constraints must accompany the model input before comparative runtime evaluation. Rubric visibility must be declared consistently; evaluator material is not silently added to the asset input.

human_calibration.executor: User coordinates at least two independent human reviewers; the assistant does not execute the experiment.
human_calibration.preparation: Synthetic examples teach anchors only. For an empirical pilot the user supplies real artifact/evidence cases, with expected answers and system identities withheld from reviewers.
human_calibration.initial_budget: 20-30 actual cases across tasks, quality levels, S2, T4 and all three K4 aspects; agree a human time budget before starting. This is not a statistical sample-size claim. No paid API calls are required.
human_calibration.real_pilot_command_adjustment: Replace --cases with the real-evidence JSON file and choose a new output folder; no overwrite is allowed.
human_calibration.rating_instruction: Use the assessment unit result_kind: integer 0-4 for existing quality ratings, integer 0-2 for compactness, or UNVERIFIED with null rating. Include concrete evidence and rationale; normalized compactness scores are 0, 0.5 and 1.
human_calibration.limits: Homogeneous or small samples can make kappa undefined or unreliable. Synthetic training is not empirical validation. Agreement does not validate point weights; inspect content coverage and sensitivity separately.

maintenance.refresh_command: Use the reviewed release-maintenance script for the current revision; legacy pilot --refresh is not the fifty-task release workflow.
maintenance.refresh_effect: Refresh canonical and shared-file hashes only after review and validation; do not silently redefine input allowlists or erase historical audit records.
maintenance.cleanup: Old images and curation records are retained. Current image-source fields and note links now use allowlisted names, with legacy-name mappings preserved. Rubrics remain JSON-only.

optional_history.portable_release_requirement: Do not dereference optional development paths when loading the benchmark.

maintenance.legacy_pilot_commands: Earlier asset_curation/rubric_pilot maintenance commands cover the original pilot and are not the fifty-task release validator.

required: Each selected task rubric.json and input_manifest.json
Every file allowlisted by that task input_manifest.json
The four shared specifications: evaluation_policy.json, evaluation_profile.json, calibration_cases.json and review_guide.json
delivery_boundary.shared_files: One shared copy serves every task through ../_evaluation relative references. Keep the shared directory when distributing any subset.
optional: Representative checker_mappings JSON drafts; they do not override scoring
Development tools, review reports, research notes, source history and historical snapshots
delivery_boundary.portable_release: Required evaluation specification and model input references remain inside selected50_protocols. Optional development archive/tool paths are informative and may be absent.
delivery_boundary.runtime_boundary: This packages the specification and input, not an implemented simulator scoring engine.

mobile_revision.old_results: Keep separate; do not rewrite archived experimental verdicts.
